name: Wrattonbully

climate: Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz, Merlot and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region in the Limestone Coast zone of South Australia. Cabernet Sauvignon makes up almost half of plantings, followed by Shiraz at 28%.
